final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. That answer is owned by security@harborlight.example and is valid until 2027-11-18. Section 4.3 (Leavers) of the Access Control Policy states the same 24-hour timeframe. No live check covers offboarding timing, so this answer comes from policy and wasn't confirmed against live systems.

policy:a787376d-f8b2-4fa0-87a9-cad258a68: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:315b0266-804d-408d-8df4-ae29c1221: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
policy:2bd63253-b591-4ddd-8bbc-bd4cf50eb: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:174e6f89-c617-47a9-8718-3e7670479: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:ca845c6c-51bb-44a3-9e9a-8733c2075: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
